page: Amazon Web Services c8id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 96 vCPUs and 48 physical cores operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory running at 7 GHz, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For high-speed local storage, the instance includes a 5700 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance across multiple compute and memory workloads. The instance achieves top-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core tests, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Passmark CPU tests, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics, also rank in the top tier. While single-core stress-ng performance is average, multi-core CPU performance is strong. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is top-tier, while large-block read and write speeds remain strong.

The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations, which drive top-tier prompt processing speeds in LLM inference benchmarks. Database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput also register in the top tier. This hardware profile delivers high resource density and compute-to-memory efficiency for high-throughput processing. The combination of dedicated compute cores, fast DDR5 memory, and high-capacity local NVMe storage makes this instance highly suitable for database hosting, software compilation, data processing, and machine learning inference workloads.
description: Amazon Web Services c8id.24xlarge is a compute-optimized instance featuring an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 96 vCPUs, 48 physical cores, and a 3.9 GHz clock speed. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of DDR5 memory and 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, operating on the Nitro hypervisor with a 40 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance delivers top-tier performance in multi-core benchmarks, software compilation, ray tracing, and database operations. Its processor supports Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512, enabling top-tier prompt processing for large language models. With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local storage, the c8id.24xlarge offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for compute-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is highly suited for database hosting, high-throughput web serving, software build pipelines, and machine learning inference.
